$comment: OpenAI API pricing used ONLY for estimating what the recorded local Ollama usage would cost on the OpenAI API. Prices are per 1,000,000 (1M) tokens in USD. cached_input_price applies to the fraction of input tokens assumed to hit the prompt cache (see --cache in report.py). long_context_tiers, when present, apply to the WHOLE request when total input tokens >= the tier's min_tokens (OpenAI long-context pricing). VERIFY THESE RATES against https://openai.com/api/pricing/ before relying on them - they are a starting point and change over time.
